chapters.title: The Formative Playlist
chapters.narrative: The story begins in July 2013 with 208 streams primarily on web player. Early listening patterns set the acoustic baseline before financial records begin.
highlights: Total hours in this era: 9 hrs

chapters.title: The Daily Ledger & The Daily Record
chapters.narrative: Spanning January 2015 to September 2018, this era captures 2,461 detailed receipts totaling ₹1,957,391 in recorded living expenses alongside 50,359 musical tracks. Transportation purchases (trains, autos, taxis) co-occur with mobile Spotify sessions across the same days.
highlights: Top payment mode: Saving Bank account 1 (1223 records)
191 verified high-scoring temporal co-occurrences with Spotify

chapters.title: The Pure Sound Interlude
chapters.narrative: Between financial record collections, 62,115 streams trace an uninterrupted 3-year audio journey. The data captures changing daily routines and evolving artist preferences during the 2020-2021 period.
highlights: Deep listening phase with high album play completion

chapters.title: Multi-Facet Mobility
chapters.narrative: From April 2022 to April 2024, 10,267 multi-facet transactions across travel, entertainment, fitness, and retail coincide with 37,178 streams across modern platforms.
highlights: Travel & entertainment dominate active lifestyle spending
